title: Knowledge
description: Reusable, organization-specific GTM knowledge learned from decision episodes, customer reactions and outcomes (HAR-97 §11). Scoped by a structured situation signature and explicit exceptions — never a slogan.

situation_signature.description: All conditions must hold for the knowledge to apply. Conditions are over AccountState fields, the buying group, open signals (ADR-0011) and the account's relationship state and open StateTransition (ADR-0012, ADR-0013). Evaluated first, together with applicability_conditions: if any condition fails the knowledge does not apply (DOES_NOT_APPLY), whatever its exceptions say.

applicability_conditions.description: Optional narrowing conditions learned after the signature (HAR-97 §11; SQL knowledge.applicability_conditions). Same grammar as situation_signature and evaluated with it: the knowledge applies only if every signature condition AND every applicability condition holds. Absent or empty means no narrowing (ADR-0013).

exceptions.description: Checked only when the signature holds: if any exception's conditions then hold, the knowledge must NOT be applied (HAR-97 §5.15, 'exception in current state that overrides the learned default'). Exceptions must be reachable, i.e. compatible with the signature.

status_history.description: Lifecycle history, oldest first (SQL knowledge_status_history, append-only, ADR-0013). The first entry has from_status null.

condition.description: One deterministic test over the situation (ADR-0013). Strings compare case-insensitively with whitespace collapsed. eq / neq: the field is known and its scalar value equals / differs from value (an unknown field satisfies neither). in: the field is known and equals one of value. contains: a list field has an item matching value (a string is a substring of the item text; an object is an itemPattern whose given keys must all match one item), or a known scalar string contains value. exists: a known, non-null, non-empty value; an open signal of that type; an engaged buying-group member (status not departed, inactive or disengaged) holding that role; an open transition. not_exists is the exact negation of exists. is_unknown: the state field (or relationship_state) is unknown. eq / in on 'buying_group.<role>' test the status of the members holding that role. A malformed or unknown condition is an error, never silently false.

field.description: An AccountState field (e.g. 'motion', 'champion_status', 'blockers'); 'buying_group.<role>'; 'diff.<signal_type>' = a signal of that type is open for this opportunity: STANDING types (signal.v1.json#/$defs/standingSignalType) while standingOpenWhile holds, EVENT types for eventWindowDays after created_at. Signals with a null opportunity_id are account-level and match every opportunity of the account; 'topic.<dimension>' (exists / not_exists) = the state diff that triggered the case touched a field of that change dimension (common.v1.json#changeDimension; ADR-0013 amendment 4); 'relationship_state' = the newest CONFIRMED relationship state or 'unknown' (ADR-0012); 'transition.from_state', 'transition.to_state' (the to_state_candidate) or 'transition.status' = the account's one open StateTransition, so knowledge can be scoped to a transition such as REORG -> EXPANSION while CANDIDATE (ADR-0013).

value.description: Required by eq, neq, in and contains; forbidden for exists, not_exists and is_unknown.

itemPattern.description: A list-item pattern for 'contains': every given key must match the same item (ADR-0013).

text.description: Substring of the item text (case-insensitive, whitespace collapsed).
